QUOTE: **Opaque barrier.** `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when asm is available. Otherwise it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`... The compiler therefore cannot prove a secret's value
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the primitive and its purpose. It never places it in library/constant_time_impl.h. It cites `constant_time_impl.h` only for the asm gate and the x86-64 `mbedtls_ct_bool`. It cites `constant_time.c:29` for `mbedtls_ct_zero`, so the location half of the item is absent.
